original_native_abi.hidden_receiver: ECX is the window receiver, the decompiler renders it as IWindow * this

ordinary_stack_arguments.use: copied verbatim into EAX and then into receiver+0x80; never dereferenced

original_native_abi.return_register: none; EAX still holds the copied stack word at the RET
original_native_abi.return_semantics: void; the body stores the argument and falls through to RET 0x4. No instruction after 0x0095fa30 writes EAX, so the copied argument word survives in EAX at the RET, and no evidence claims that residue as a returned value.
original_native_abi.derived_from: disassembly plus live memory reads; the briefing abi section was empty and evidence.missing_sections listed ABI
original_native_abi.ghidra_convention_note: The live decompilation warns 'Unknown calling convention' and renders the signature as (IWindow * this, IWindow * pChildWindow) with return type bool, then prints 'return SUB41(this,0);' for an unmodelled callee. The three-instruction body contains no call, so the decompiled bool return is an artifact of the unrepaired convention, not an observed returned value.

body_evidence.raw_bytes_note: 13 body bytes; the byte read at 0x0095fa3d is 0xcc padding, not part of the function

observed_mechanics: 0x0095fa30-0x0095fa33 MOV EAX,dword ptr [ESP+0x4] loads the single stack word into EAX; ECX is untouched, so the body has no prologue and saves no register.
0x0095fa34-0x0095fa39 MOV dword ptr [ECX+0x80],EAX writes the raw stack word to receiver+0x80 without any load, compare, mask, or null test.
0x0095fa3a-0x0095fa3c C2 04 00 is RET 0x4, so the callee pops the one 4-byte argument word and there is no stack cleanup beyond it.
The body holds no CALL, no branch, no flag test, no arithmetic and no second memory access, so the function is one unconditional dword store and nothing else.
No instruction after the 0x0095fa30 load writes EAX, so the copied argument word is still in EAX at the RET; whether any virtual caller consumes AL is not observable here.

observed_mechanics_detail.receiver_reads: none; no receiver field is loaded, so the store is independent of prior state
observed_mechanics_detail.argument_reads: one dword at [ESP+0x4]; the argument value is never dereferenced, so a null argument is stored like any other value
observed_mechanics_detail.flags: no comparison and no arithmetic, so no EFLAGS bit is defined by this body
observed_mechanics_detail.not_rewritten: nothing else in the receiver or in any global is touched, so repeated calls are idempotent except for the slot itself

call_graph.caller_evidence: ghidra_get_function_callers and ghidra_get_function_callees at 0x0095fa30 both returned zero; every reference is a DATA word, so reachability is through containing pointer tables only

vtable_evidence.briefing_list_reconciliation: The briefing vtables field lists 12 entries. Four of them (0x013fdb6c, 0x0140f854, 0x01414c14, 0x014151cc) are confirmed live function-word slots. The other eight are exactly 0x30 or 0x54 below a confirmed slot (0x013fdb18 -> 0x013fdb6c, 0x01414bc0 -> 0x01414c14, 0x01414ed4 -> 0x01414f04, 0x01415178 -> 0x014151cc, 0x0141873c -> 0x0141876c, 0x014190d4 -> 0x01419104, 0x0141930c -> 0x0141933c, 0x014195ac -> 0x014195dc), so the triage list mixes presumed table bases with real slot words.
vtable_evidence.not_claimed: No table base, slot index, slot displacement, class identity or RTTI record is claimed, because the two readings of the triage list are indistinguishable from the available evidence and SporeApp.exe carries no MSVC RTTI.
vtable_evidence.receiver_vptr: Because the containing tables have no proven base, the displacement of the receiver vtable pointer inside the object is also unproven, so the modeled receiver prefix 0x00-0x7f stays opaque and the layout struct carries no vtable member.

semantic_findings.statement: 0x0095fa30 is an unconditional four-byte publication of its first stack word into receiver+0x80, with a void RET 0x4 and no other effect.

name_body_conflict.observation: A function that answers an ancestor query must read receiver state and return a boolean. The recovered body reads no receiver field, calls nothing, compares nothing and stores the argument instead, so the SDK name, its bool return and its pChildWindow reading are not corroborated by the body.
name_body_conflict.treatment: The normalized symbol keeps the SDK-derived words so the validator can locate the span, and the argument name stays neutral. No ancestor query, no boolean result and no child-window semantics are claimed.

failure_boundaries.null_argument: The null word is stored at receiver+0x80 like any other value; the body has no null guard and the model adds none.
failure_boundaries.invalid_receiver: The store faults at receiver+0x80 with no partial state change, because the body performs no other memory access.
failure_boundaries.aliasing: If the argument pointer aliases the receiver plus a small displacement, the single store is still the only effect; no read of the destination precedes the write.

model_boundary.represented: The ECX receiver, the single unconditional dword store to receiver+0x80, the one callee-cleaned 4-byte stack word, the void RET 0x4 return, and the absence of any call, branch, flag test or register save.

runtime_gates: Observe a real virtual call through one of the 33 function words and record the receiver instance state before and after the store at receiver+0x80.
Record the runtime value stored at receiver+0x80 and whether the same word is later consumed as a window pointer, a vtable-adjacent field or a reference count carrier.
Observe whether any caller consumes AL after the RET 0x4, which would give the EAX residue a real contract the static body cannot prove.
Record the real receiver allocation size, because the 0x84 byte modeled extent is only the prefix through the written slot.
Confirm the containing table base and slot displacement of at least one of the 33 references so the shared-vtable analogue chain can be grounded.
unresolved_questions: The briefing carried no ABI section (evidence.missing_sections listed ABI), so the recorded ABI is derived from the three-instruction disassembly and the live raw bytes; a repaired Ghidra calling convention should confirm the thiscall receiver and the RET 0x4 cleanup.

Why does the SDK name IsAncestorOf and a bool return contradict a body that only stores its argument? The ModAPI import may be offset, and sibling exports show the same pattern, but the correct name and signature are unresolved.
Is the EAX residue at the RET meaningful to any caller, and does any of the 33 virtual slots get its result from AL?
Which table owns each of the 33 function words, at which slot index, and are the 0x30 and 0x54 displacements real slot positions or an artifact of the triage scan?
What is the field at receiver+0x80 in the real UTFWin::Window layout, what writes it besides this function, and what reads it afterwards?
Is the stored word a window pointer, a vtable-adjacent pointer, or a reference-counted handle? The decompiler types it as IWindow * but nothing here proves that.
What receiver vtable displacement do the containing tables imply for the receiver, and is the receiver polymorphic at offset 0x00?
Which concrete classes and runtime windows reach this slot, given that no direct caller exists?
